output.explanation: Implemented all 11 b06 edits using the pinned source revision. Added Agent Chat ownership/runtime, current reads/publication, and push intake trees. Preserved workspace autosave versus catalog publication, runtime versus durable identities, and proposal generation versus acceptance. Explicit comparisonBase/null now distinguishes net push evidence from first-parent commit evidence. All diagrams fit their reserved bounds; new trees have exactly 38/44/36/32 nodes, and both existing DiffSession trees retain 40 nodes. Existing attachment labels remain exact. These boundaries establish the foundation for later MCP refinements and managed child generation without depicting those features as implemented.
